description.content:
Public endpoint: returns the data schema for a phase. Used by forithmus-cli.

The schema is sanitized for non-admins: ground-truth structure and real
sample content (reports, case IDs) are stripped so the answer key is never
exposed. Challenge admins / platform staff get the full schema.

Check if a phase is ready to enable submissions. Admin only.
Returns readiness flags for test data, ground truth, eval container,
baseline scoring, and (for private challenges) subscription + pool status.

Re-detect data schema from already-uploaded files. Admin only.
Triggers a background task that downloads sample files from GCS,
scans shapes/formats, and merges detected info into data_schema.
Edit a phase's settings. Admin only.
